title: David Spares Saul's Life in the Cave
description: Saul pursues David in the wilderness of En-Gedi and enters a cave where David and his men are hiding. David secretly cuts off a corner of Saul's cloak but regrets it and refuses to harm the Lord's anointed. Afterwards, he calls out to Saul and shows him the piece as proof of his innocence. Saul weeps, acknowledges David's righteousness and that David will become king.
